title: How a 19-year-old intern built the growth engine behind this $2B AI company | Hector Serrano
summary: How a 19 year old intern built the growth engine behind Wispr Flow
detailed: 19-year-old intern Hector Serrano serves as Head of Content at AI voice-to-text tool Wispr Flow, managing a growth program built on creator partnerships.
Serrano built a roster of 50 creators producing between 500 and 600 paid user-generated content (UGC) ads monthly, with top creators earning over $13,000 per month.
The paid UGC strategy adapts a Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) marketing playbook for Software-as-a-Service (SaaS).
Over the past year, Wispr Flow grew its revenue by 30 times and raised funding at a $2 billion valuation.
sentences: Hector Serrano runs one of the most innovative and successful paid growth programs in Silicon Valley.
As Head of Content at Wispr Flow, a leading AI voice-to-text tool, he built a roster of 50 creators who drive 500 to 600 paid user-generated content (UGC) ads every month.
The creators are paid a cut of ad spend, and the best of them earn over $13,000 a month.
It’s a playbook the best DTC brands have used for years, now adapted for SaaS.
Hector joined Wispr Flow at 19, before the product had PMF, and over the past year, Wispr Flow has grown revenue 30x and raised at a $2 billion valuation.
